# Distance Formatting Checklist: Format distances with a small library

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for displayed distance text and for the new third-party formatting package are clear, complete and consistent before PR review.
**Created**: 2026-11-13
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/format-distance.md](../contracts/format-distance.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the set of places where distances are displayed listed exhaustively (route list entries, fastest-route summary), and does it state whether any other surface (map popups, tooltips, stop list) shows distances? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK002 - Is the rounding step that comes before choosing a unit defined explicitly (to whole metres), rather than only implied by "(after rounding)"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK003 - Is the kilometre rounding mode specified (half-up vs. half-even vs. floating-point behaviour, e.g. 1,050 m and 1,150 m)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK004 - Is the placeholder for an invalid or missing distance specified as one exact value, rather than "nothing or a neutral placeholder"? [Gap, Spec §FR-008, Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK005 - Are negative distances classified (invalid vs. formatted)? [Gap, Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK006 - Is the exact fallback output format defined when the package cannot be loaded, including which of FR-002 to FR-004 it must still meet? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK007 - Do the requirements state whether the fallback path itself must be covered by automated tests? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK008 - Does FR-010 also require documenting any new contributor step (installing dependencies before running tests)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010, SC-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 - Are "small", "well-known", "widely downloaded" and "actively published" quantified (e.g. size ceiling, download threshold, release recency)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK010 - Is "permissive licence" defined by an allow-list (e.g. MIT, ISC, BSD, Apache-2.0)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK011 - Is "no transitive runtime dependencies preferred" a hard requirement or a tie-breaker? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK012 - Is "at a pinned version" defined precisely (exact version vs. range), and must the CDN version equal the version declared for the tests? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK013 - Does FR-004 specify whether the space between number and unit is a normal space or a non-breaking space? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK014 - Is the unit spelling and casing ("m", "km", never "M"/"KM"/"meters") stated as a requirement, not only shown in examples? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK015 - Is the "no thousands separator" rule (only in Edge Cases) also stated in the functional requirements next to the decimal-separator rule? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK016 - Does SC-005 ("no hand-written unit selection or rounding logic left") conflict with FR-006 (a fallback that "follows FR-002 to FR-004 where possible") and FR-008 (custom invalid-input handling)? [Conflict, Spec §SC-005, §FR-006, §FR-008] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK017 - Is SC-003 ("exactly one new runtime dependency") consistent with loading the package from a CDN, i.e. is it clear whether the CDN script and the package.json entry count as one dependency? [Consistency, Spec §SC-003, §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK018 - Are the User Story 1 acceptance scenarios consistent with the 999.6 m → "1 km" edge case and the FR-003 boundary wording? [Consistency, Spec §US1, Edge Cases] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 - Is SC-001 ("100% of distances") bounded to a defined input set so it can be verified objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK020 - Can SC-005 ("shrinks to a thin call") be verified objectively, e.g. with a stated size or a list of forbidden constructs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK021 - Does every edge case in the spec have an exact expected output string (not "nothing or a placeholder" / "may fall back")? [Acceptance Criteria, Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for a package that loads slowly (not failing, but delayed), including whether the app may wait for it before the first map or route display? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK023 - Are values just below and above each boundary covered (999.4 / 999.5 / 999.6 m; 9,999.96 m; 0.5 m)? [Coverage, Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK024 - Is the behaviour for non-numeric inputs listed separately (undefined, null, numeric strings, Infinity), or covered by one rule? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK025 - Do the requirements say whether distances inside routes with stops (multi-leg totals) follow the same rules as single-leg routes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK026 - Are supply-chain integrity requirements stated for the CDN-loaded package (e.g. subresource integrity or explicit acceptance of the same trust model as the map library)? [Gap, Security, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by Pilot, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK027 - Is the minimum browser support stated, given that the loading approach may rely on newer browser features? [Gap, Dependency, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK028 - Are accessibility expectations for the abbreviated units (e.g. screen readers announcing "m"/"km") either specified or explicitly out of scope? [Gap, Accessibility] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK029 - Has the assumption that the route list and summary are the only distance displays been checked against the current UI? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-13
- [x] CHK030 - Is the reliance on unpkg's availability documented as an accepted risk with an owner? [Assumption, Dependency, Spec §FR-006, Clarifications] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-13

## Notes

- Defaults applied (non-interactive run): depth Standard; audience reviewer at PR time; focus on the two most relevant areas: (1) displayed distance format and edge cases, (2) the third-party package (selection, CDN loading, fallback).
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
